propDocs.OTPInput.maxLength: Number of characters and visual slots.
propDocs.OTPInput.pattern: Accepts digits, letters, alphanumeric characters or a per-character regular expression.

propDocs.OTPInput.required: Requires a complete code in a form.
propDocs.OTPInputSlot.index: Zero-based character rendered by the slot.
